---
title: "Leadership"
---

## How I operate at Staff / Lead level

### Direction
I translate ambiguous product questions into measurable outcomes, analytical
roadmaps and decision frameworks.

### Leverage
I build reusable metric definitions, experimentation standards, self-service
data products and review mechanisms that improve the work of multiple teams.

### Influence
I communicate uncertainty, trade-offs and recommendations to product,
engineering, design and executive stakeholders.

### Quality
I establish standards for analytical validity, reproducibility, monitoring,
documentation and responsible use of data.
